_readme: EDIT THIS FILE to add, remove or change connectors. Never edit the generated tables or .mcp.json files by hand: the 'Connectors sync' Action rewrites them from this file. See docs/add-a-connector.md.

servers.name: notion
servers.signin: Notion login, choose pages to share
servers.if_fails: Share the pages with the integration

servers.name: atlassian
servers.if_fails: Confirm site access

servers.name: hubspot
servers.if_fails: Needs permission to read deals

servers.name: gong
servers.unlocks: Transcripts for ICP, alternatives, proof points
servers.if_fails: Ask your Gong admin to enable the MCP integration

servers.name: intercom
servers.if_fails: Needs read access to conversations

servers.name: slack
servers.if_fails: Join the channels you want read

servers.name: google-drive
servers.unlocks: Find and read files, decks and PDFs
servers.if_fails: Same: use the built-in Claude connector if the plugin sign-in fails

servers.name: google-docs
servers.if_fails: Google lists this server as Developer Preview. If sign-in fails, use Drive or paste the text

servers.name: google-sheets
servers.if_fails: Same Developer Preview note. If sign-in fails, export to CSV and paste

servers.name: google-slides
servers.if_fails: Same Developer Preview note. If sign-in fails, use Drive or paste the text

servers.name: linear
servers.if_fails: Check workspace access

servers.name: figma
servers.if_fails: Share the file

servers.name: canva
servers.if_fails: Open the design to your account

servers.name: gmail
servers.if_fails: If sign-in fails, enable the built-in Claude Gmail connector in Claude settings instead

servers.name: google-calendar
servers.if_fails: Same: use the built-in Claude connector if the plugin sign-in fails

servers.name: klaviyo
servers.if_fails: Needs access to the Klaviyo account

servers.name: supermetrics
servers.if_fails: Needs a Supermetrics plan with the data sources you want

servers.name: amplitude
servers.label: Amplitude (US and EU)
servers.if_fails: EU workspaces use the separate `amplitude-eu` server. Ignore the one that does not match your region

servers.name: amplitude-eu
servers.if_fails: EU workspaces use the separate `amplitude-eu` server. Ignore the one that does not match your region

servers.name: mixpanel
servers.label: Mixpanel (US and EU)
servers.if_fails: US and EU workspaces use separate servers (`mixpanel`, `mixpanel-eu`). Ignore the one that does not match your region. India workspaces: add `https://mcp-in.mixpanel.com/mcp` as a custom connector

servers.name: mixpanel-eu
servers.if_fails: US and EU workspaces use separate servers (`mixpanel`, `mixpanel-eu`). Ignore the one that does not match your region. India workspaces: add `https://mcp-in.mixpanel.com/mcp` as a custom connector

servers.name: asana
servers.if_fails: This repo uses Asana's v2 server. Asana's older SSE address is deprecated

servers.name: wispr-flow
servers.unlocks: Meeting transcripts, summaries and notes from Wispr Flow Notetaker
servers.if_fails: Needs Notetaker and MCP access on your account, and an active HIPAA agreement blocks it. Wispr's docs do not cover Claude Code: if sign-in fails, add it as a connector in Claude settings, or paste transcripts

servers.name: semrush
servers.unlocks: Competitor traffic, keyword demand and organic positioning
servers.if_fails: Needs a Semrush plan with API units. SEO data comes with Semrush One or SEO Classic plans, traffic and market data with the Trends API

servers.name: crunchbase
servers.unlocks: Funding, headcount and leadership changes for a named company
servers.if_fails: Needs a Crunchbase MCP seat assigned by your workspace admin. In Claude Code the connector only loads when you are signed in with a Claude.ai subscription, not an API key

servers.name: exa
servers.unlocks: Web search and page fetch for competitor and market signals
servers.if_fails: Rate-limited without an account. For your own Exa usage, add `https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp?login` as a custom connector

connect_your_own.documents: Hosted MCP servers use per-user OAuth 2.0 with PKCE and are aimed at customers with Flex Credits. The docs give no public endpoint
connect_your_own.todo: Ask your Salesforce admin for your org's server address

connect_your_own.documents: GitHub hosts an official remote server at `https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/`. Sign-in needs either a personal access token or an OAuth app that your host has been set up with. Whether Claude Code's own OAuth works with it is not confirmed
connect_your_own.todo: Add it yourself with your own token kept in your environment, or paste issues and release notes. Never put the token in `.mcp.json`; the structure check blocks it

connect_your_own.documents: Each customer gets their own endpoint and sign-in
connect_your_own.todo: Ask your admin or customer success manager

connect_your_own.documents: No official general-purpose hosted server was found as of August 2026. Partner and community servers exist. Zendesk is retiring API tokens (none can be created from 27 October 2026), so token-based community servers will stop working
connect_your_own.todo: Paste an export, or use a partner server that signs in with OAuth

connect_your_own.documents: Managed server with one endpoint per database and schema: `https://<account_url>/api/v2/databases/{database}/schemas/{schema}/mcp-servers/{name}`. Snowflake OAuth
connect_your_own.todo: Create the server in your account, then add it as a custom connector

connect_your_own.documents: Zoom hosts an official server over streamable HTTP. Its docs page does not list the address or sign-in steps
connect_your_own.todo: Take the address from Zoom's developer docs, or paste transcripts

connect_your_own.documents: Official read-only server, reported as an admin-enabled add-on for customers with an Agent package
connect_your_own.todo: Ask your Salesloft admin. Clari and Outreach: no official server found, paste exports

connect_your_own.documents: Runs on your machine as a CLI over stdio (`clay mcp`) and signs in with `clay login` or an API key in your environment
connect_your_own.todo: Add it as a local server in your own Claude settings. Never put the key in `.mcp.json`; the structure check blocks it
Paste exports. Avoid servers that scrape the site
